title: Chicago-based restaurant software startup Chowbus raised an $81M Series E led by Prysm Capital and Left Lane Capital; it focuses primarily on Asian restaurants (Natalie Breymeyer/Axios)
summary: Natalie Breymeyer / Axios: Chicago-based restaurant software startup Chowbus raised an $81M Series E led by Prysm Capital and Left Lane Capital; it focuses primarily on Asian restaurants — Chowbus, an operating system for independent Asian restaurants, raised an $81m Series E, CEO Linxin Wen tells Axios exclusively.
